fields.System.Title: FDN-802 — Delivery worker
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want a background worker that delivers outbox events, so that a slow
or absent consumer never slows down warehouse work.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given unsent events, when the worker runs, then it delivers them and marks them
  • sent.
  • - Given events for the same aggregate, then they are delivered in the order they
  • occurred.
  • - Given the worker crashes after delivering but before marking sent, then the event is
  • delivered again on the next run — at-least-once, by design.
  • - Given the worker, then it runs as a separate process from the API, using the same
  • codebase.
  • - Given several worker instances, then an event is claimed by only one of them.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | outbox |
| Risks | Duplicate delivery to a non-idempotent consumer ([doc 09 §3.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); out-of-order delivery ([doc 08 §10](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration · concurrency (two workers) |
